_comment: Store listing source for scripts/build_stores.py. The version comes from .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Edit this file, then run python3 scripts/build_stores.py.
name: meetstream
description: Meeting bots for Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams: send a bot to a call, then get the recording, the transcript, the participants and the chat, or stream live data during the call. Includes the hosted MeetStream MCP server (browser sign-in) and skills for notetakers, sales coaches, calendar auto-recording and voice agents.
longDescription: MeetStream is meeting-bot infrastructure. A bot joins a Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams call as a visible participant, records it and transcribes it. Ask your agent to send a bot to a meeting link, then get the transcript, an AI summary, the recording, the participants and the in-meeting chat. Build tracks: 1) the Recording bot, with post-call or real-time transcription; 2) the Bridge server, for an agent in the meeting on your own stack; 3) the hosted Agents API for voice agents (bring-your-own-infra and local-agent options are coming soon). Zoom bots join through your own Zoom app with an OBF or ZAK token, so set up a Zoom Meeting SDK app before the first Zoom bot. Sign in once in the browser through the hosted MeetStream MCP server; no API key is pasted into the chat.
capabilities: Send a recording bot to a Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams meeting
Get transcripts, AI summaries, recordings, participants and chat after a call
Stream live transcripts and meeting events during a call
Schedule bots for Google Calendar meetings
Create and manage hosted voice agents

Get the transcript and action items from my last recorded meeting

openai.release_notes: Skills for MeetStream meeting bots (recording, transcripts, live data, calendar, voice agents) and the hosted MeetStream MCP server with OAuth sign-in.

positive.description: Send a recording bot to a meeting the reviewer starts
positive.prompt: Send a MeetStream bot named Notetaker to my meeting at <REVIEWER_TEST_MEETING_URL> and record it.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_bot with the meeting link and bot name, returns the bot_id and tells the user that the host must admit the bot.

positive.prompt: Show my recent MeetStream bots and their status.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_bots and shows each bot with its meeting link, status and creation time. An empty list is a valid answer.

positive.description: Get a transcript of a finished meeting
positive.prompt: Get the transcript of my most recent recorded meeting.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_bots to find the latest bot with status Done, then get_transcript for that bot_id, and shows the transcript with speaker names.

positive.prompt: What were the action items in my last meeting?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_bots, then get_bot_summary for the latest finished bot, and lists the action items from the summary.

positive.prompt: How much MeetStream credit do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_balance and reports the balance. If the balance is low, gives the billing link from top_up_link or the response.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin is not used. No MeetStream tool is called.

negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a string.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin is not used. No MeetStream tool is called.
The plugin is not used. No MeetStream tool is called.
